component: Depth-bounded prefill chunk (opt-in) and Metal GPU-timeout step recovery
source_read: PR description only (local pr-index snapshot); the patch body was not read or copied
idea: A fixed prefill chunk at deep KV can run one Metal command buffer past the GPU watchdog (kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorTimeout). omlx makes the step min(configured step, largest power of two <= budget / (depth + step)), floored at 128, with an empirical budget of 1.6e8 tokens^2 measured on a two-node M5 Pro pipeline of Qwen3.8-27B-oQ4e-mtp.
modifications: Own implementation: runtime/prefill_plan.depth_bounded_prefill_rows keeps the configured step while rows x (depth + rows) <= budget (so every chunk ending at or before budget // step is unchanged), else the largest power of two that fits, floor 128.

Applied in BatchGenerator on the ordinary, mixed and self-MTP prefill paths, before APC interior checkpoint clamping; engagement counter prefill_depth_bounded_chunks; chunk receipt field depth_budget.

Policy-driven, no model-name branching: --prefill-depth-budget or adapter prefill_depth_budget_default() (FlashNextPolicy.prefill_depth_budget = None). Bound into qualification settings only when set; fails closed on external-draft / prompt-lookup routes.

Not in omlx#4149: serving now classifies the Metal GPU-timeout step failure and recovers it exactly as Metal OOM (fail in-flight lanes 503, verify memory, rebuild), plus a qualification mlx_fault kind gpu_timeout.

validation.default_state: off: on this M5 Max the shipped chunks (Flash-Next 8192, engine 2048) stay far below the watchdog through 262K; see README
